selection_data: Outer clean held-out examples in development seeds 0-4 only. Inner validation selects depth or prunes a tree. Final evaluation seeds 100-109 have not been run.
settings_policy: For every new dataset, choose depth from 2, 4, 6, and number of attributes using only its inner validation balanced accuracy; break ties by fewer nodes and then shallower actual depth.

dtl.reason: Lower outer development held-out balanced accuracy than the selected policy. Preserved as an ablation; no further search.
